$comment: ORBIT task manifest: the single source of truth for who does what. BUILD MODEL: tasks with a "builder" field are coded by Claude in Ayman's session; their "owner" DECIDES the customization (asked in plan mode) and REVIEWS the result. Tasks without "builder" are done by the owner. Owner of this file: Hardik (Claude edits it through PRs). Hours are counted from the start of the hackathon (H0). Priorities: P0 = demo breaks without it, P1 = should have, P2 = nice to have. See docs/PLAYBOOK.md#task-system.

Arham.role: Decides visual direction, layout and globe look; reviews all UI

Ayman.role: Drives the Claude build session and relays team decisions; decides the country, event and timeline views

Affan.role: Decides AI behaviour and tone; provides the AI key; reviews AI output

Shrey.role: Decides which countries and events feature; verifies researched facts; runs demo rehearsal

Hardik.role: Integrator: reviews and merges every PR, runs sync points and the demo laptop

tasks.title: Foundation skeleton
tasks.description: Contracts, API server, seed data, routes, placeholder features, design tokens, tests, docs, task manifest and agent rules.
acceptance: npm run check passes
npm run dev shows the globe and the country/event panels with mock data
tasks.handoff: Pushed as main of the orbit repo. Hardik reviews it (ORB-HAR-01). After that, everyone branches from main.

tasks.title: Review the foundation and confirm every laptop runs it
tasks.description: The foundation is on main of https://github.com/Ayman-Alam-India/orbit. Review it (report problems to Ayman), then ask all five people to clone the repo, run npm install, npm run check and npm run dev, and confirm the globe shows.
acceptance: Foundation reviewed on main
All five people report npm run check passing on their own laptop
tasks.handoff: Post 'main is ready, branch now' in the team chat. Every other task can start.

tasks.title: Integration sync points
tasks.description: Every ~4 hours: merge ready PRs (shared/ changes first), then run npm run check and npm run dev on main and click through Global -> Country -> Event -> Ask. Handle contract-change requests (docs/INTEGRATION.md).
acceptance: main passes npm run check after every sync
Contract changes land before the features that need them
tests: npm run check on main after each merge batch
tasks.handoff: After each sync, post in the chat what merged and what everyone should pull.

tasks.title: Live news enrichment with offline fallback
tasks.description: In server/sources/index.ts, implement DATA_MODE=live for getNewsFeed: fetch headlines from one free news or data API, map them to NewsHeadlineSchema, validate, writeCache, merge with seed. Any failure logs [sources] and returns cache, then seed. Add the API key name (empty) to .env.example if one is needed.
acceptance: DATA_MODE=mock behaves exactly as before
DATA_MODE=live returns live + seed headlines, all valid NewsHeadline objects
With wifi off, DATA_MODE=live still returns cached or seed headlines
No API key in the repository
tests: server/sources/news.test.ts: mapping + fallback with fetch mocked
tasks.handoff: Tell Shrey (news panel) that live headlines exist and which sourceIds they use.

tasks.title: Demo hardening and offline check
tasks.description: On the demo laptop: warm the caches in live mode, then turn wifi off and run the full demo path from docs/DEMO.md. Fix failures in your own folders; report failures in other folders to their owner. Make sure an .env with DATA_MODE and AI_PROVIDER set for the demo exists on that laptop only.
acceptance: Full demo path works with wifi off
No console errors during the demo path
tasks.handoff: Tell the team the demo laptop is frozen: only fixes for bugs found in rehearsal after this.

tasks.title: Get a free-tier AI key and configure it locally
tasks.description: Create a Google AI Studio (Gemini) API key on the free tier. Copy .env.example to .env and set AI_PROVIDER=google and GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY. The key goes only in your local .env: never in code, commits or chat.
acceptance: git status does not show .env
GET /api/health shows aiProvider 'google' once ORB-AFF-02 lands
tasks.handoff: If a different free provider is needed, ask Hardik to install its @ai-sdk package and add the key name to .env.example.

tasks.title: Real AI provider (Gemini via Vercel AI SDK)
tasks.description: Implement server/ai/providers/google.ts with the installed 'ai' and '@ai-sdk/google' packages. generateInsight and ask must return objects that pass AIInsightSchema / AskAnswerSchema. Use only the AiContext given (no extra fetching). sourceIds may only contain IDs present in the context. Keep the automatic mock fallback in server/ai/index.ts working.
acceptance: AI_PROVIDER=google returns real answers for global, country and event insights and for /api/ask
With the key missing or wifi off, responses still arrive from the mock provider
All output passes the shared schemas
tests: server/ai/ai.test.ts: fallback to mock when the provider throws; output validated
tasks.handoff: Tell Hardik and the team which model you used and its free-tier rate limits.

tasks.title: Explanation (insight) panel
tasks.description: Replace the InsightCard placeholder with the final explanation UI: summary, key points, cited sources (resolved via /api/sources), confidence and provider shown clearly. Use src/ui primitives and tokens only.
acceptance: Works for global, country and event subjects
Loading, error and empty states shown
Sources are listed by name
tasks.handoff: Tell Ayman and Arham the component API stays <InsightCard subjectType subjectId />.

tasks.title: Ask ORBIT experience
tasks.description: Replace the AskPanel placeholder with the final chat-style panel: question history for the session, context chip showing what ORBIT is looking at, answer with cited sources. Streaming is optional: if you want it, propose the API change first (docs/INTEGRATION.md, contract change).
acceptance: Question is sent with the current country/event context
Loading and error states shown
Works with the mock provider
tasks.handoff: Tell Arham if the panel needs a different size or position in the layout.

tasks.title: Cache AI answers for the demo
tasks.description: Save successful real-provider insights to the disk cache (server/sources/cache.ts: readCache/writeCache) keyed by subject, and serve them when the provider fails, before falling back to mock.
acceptance: With wifi off, previously viewed insights show the real (cached) text
tests: server/ai/ai.test.ts: serves cached insight when the provider throws
tasks.handoff: Tell Hardik so ORB-HAR-04 warms the AI cache before the demo.

tasks.title: Design system pass
tasks.description: Refine src/styles/tokens.css and the src/ui primitives (Panel, Loader, ErrorState, SeverityBadge, ItemList) and add the missing ones the team needs first: Button and Tag. Keep docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md in sync.
acceptance: No raw colours outside tokens.css
Every primitive exported from src/ui/index.ts
DESIGN_SYSTEM.md lists every token group and primitive
tasks.handoff: Post the list of primitives in the chat so feature owners switch to them.

tasks.title: App shell and layout
tasks.description: Final layout in src/layout/: top bar, overlay panel column with enter/exit transitions between routes, Ask ORBIT placement, works from 1280px to 1920px wide.
acceptance: Globe stays mounted across route changes
Panels scroll independently of the globe
Back button works

tasks.title: Cinematic 3D globe
tasks.description: Upgrade src/globe/OrbitGlobe.tsx: glow/atmosphere, country colouring by riskLevel for seeded countries, event markers styled by kind and severity (tokens via cssVar), pulsing rings for severity >= 4, slow auto-rotate on the global view, smooth fly-to on selection.

Smooth on the demo laptop

tasks.title: Claim-level verification of AI insights
tasks.description: Split each AI insight into individual claims and check every claim against ORBIT data and its cited sources: supported, unsupported or contradicted, with the evidence used. Works offline with a rule-based verifier.
